characters.description: Mara Linden, a 52-year-old woman forest steward, olive skin, short silver-streaked dark curls, calm knowing smile, forest-green ranger vest over cream shirt, ochre trousers and practical boots, holds a folded forest map and small seed pouch.
Jonas Reed, a 28-year-old male forest gardener, dark brown skin, short coiled hair, kind open smile, sage overalls with terracotta shirt, boots, holds an unlabelled seedling tray with tiny saplings.

Leila Moss, a 35-year-old female riverside market host, brown skin, long dark hair in a braided bun, warm expressive face, teal apron with copper clasps over pale linen tunic and aubergine trousers, holds a small basket of pastries.

Bram Holt, a 61-year-old male former sawmill mechanic, pale weathered skin, grey beard, chestnut knit cap, deep russet work jacket and navy overalls, sturdy boots, holds a worn wrench and wooden toolbox; thoughtful kind smile.

Tessa Vale, a 32-year-old female reclaimed-wood craftsperson, freckled fair skin, tied-back copper hair, moss green work shirt and tan apron with rolled sleeves and charcoal trousers, boots, holds a small sanded wooden bird carving.

Silas Brook, a 42-year-old male river-path musician, olive skin, wavy shoulder length brown hair, neat short beard, indigo overshirt and light brown trousers, boots, holds a compact acoustic guitar by the neck at his side; relaxed smile.

Nora Finch, a 47-year-old female community archivist, fair skin, chin-length black hair with silver streak, round glasses, mustard cardigan over teal shirt and dark olive trousers, boots, holds a worn notebook and pencil; attentive curious expression.

Owen Pike, a 55-year-old male former rail dispatcher, East Asian appearance, salt-and-pepper short hair, thoughtful warm expression, navy vest with brass buttons over faded blue shirt and olive trousers, sturdy boots, holds a clipboard with no legible marks and a folded route map.

sign.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: Unity isometric forest-river town welcome-sign prop. Create a charming handcrafted weathered wood sign with two stout wooden posts and carved decorative oak leaves, copper brackets, small moss accents and a little kingfisher sitting on one post. Exact readable text centered on signboard in two lines: "MARK WOOD" and "CITY". Polished hand-painted casual town-game art, warm soft light, forest green and walnut brown palette, subtle isometric three-quarter angle, whole sign and posts completely inside canvas with a margin. Genuine transparent alpha background, clean cutout, no ground or scenery, no backdrop, no watermark. Landscape canvas 1536x1024.
